question: Four letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the letter-cluster that is different.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73e690c12a66adaf209adf0b1ff008bb704c48783bd537b818e9d442fb16b230.png] 

The logic followed here is:

 
• **FCHP → F - 3 = C; C + 5 = H; H + 8 = P**
 
• JGLS → J - 3 = G; G + 5 = L; L + 7 = S
 
• WTYF → W - 3 = T; T + 5 = Y; Y + 7 = F
 
• NKPW → N - 3 = K; K + 5 = P; P + 7 = W

Hence, '**FCHP**' is the odd one out.
